traits.name: Divine Aura
traits.text:
Each time an aberration, fiend, or undead attempts
to make a melee or ranged attack against the wrath dragon from
within 10 feet of the dragon, the creature must succeed on a
DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to target another
creature within range or lose the action. Once a creature
succeeds on this saving throw, it is immune to it for 24
hours.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
traits.text:
If the dragon fails a
saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The wrath dragon is a 15th level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared: * Cantrips (at will): guidance, mending, resistance, sacred flame, thaumaturgy * 1st level (4 slots): bane, bless, cure wounds, detect magic, guiding bolt * 2nd level (3 slots): aid, find traps, hold person, lesser restoration, silence, spiritual weapon * 3rd level (3 slots): beacon of hope, dispel magic, revivify * 4th level (3 slots): banishment, death ward, freedom of movement, guardian of faith * 5th level (2 slots): commune, dispel evil and good, greater restoration, mass cure wound, raise dead * 6th level (1 slot): heal * 7th level (1 slot): divine word * 8th level (1 slot): holy aura

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The wrath dragon makes three attacks: one
with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one
target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one
target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit:
15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.
Divine Breath (Recharge 5–6). The wrath dragon releases a blast of
divine fire in a 60-foot cone. Creatures within the area must make a DC 19
Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage and 28 (8d6) radiant
damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful
saving throw.

actions.name: Beckon Deva (1/day)
actions.text:
The wrath dragon summons a deva from the deity
that it serve. The summoned deva appears in an unoccupied space within 60
feet of the wrath dragon. It remains for 1 minute, until it or the wrath dragon
is slain, or until the wrath dragon takes an action to dismiss it.
